name: Mall Escalator Landing
summary: Compact ribbed escalator landing with two access plates, recessed support tray, side trims and a simplified comb transition.
description: V2.1 P0 item 429: static modular landing threshold only, not a full escalator or moving transport. Eight independently editable meshes in metres. Existing floor module 421 fits at a verified flush nominal top; future escalator interface remains provisional.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python geometry and Principled materials. No external models, textures, logos or fonts. Actual original project 421 floor used for separate assembly evidence only.

display.front_axis: mall floor at Blender -Y / glTF +Z; future escalator at opposite side

assembly.instructions: Place unchanged 421 floor root at glTF (0,0,1.2) for the front connection, or (+/-1.2,0,0) beside side trims. No scaling. Both wear surfaces at Y=0.03; existing 421 perimeter grout is deliberately 1 mm lower. Future escalator envelope is provisional only, no compatibility claim.

material_notes: Two closed ribbed access-plate meshes, two trims, threshold, tray, closed comb and marker. Five editable named materials; front/rear plates share satin aluminium. 25 coarse ribs per plate and 27 coarse comb fingers; no textures/animations/decoder dependencies.
accuracy_notes: Visual architecture asset only. No moving transport, mechanical compatibility, slip resistance, engineering, manufacturer, safety or building-code certification. Future escalator asset 430 is not included or tested.

attribution.credit: Original geometry and materials for Blender-3D-Gallery; existing original floor module 421 unchanged in separate assembly verification only.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.

quality_gate.scope: Local source, geometry, floor joints, rendering and Gallery checks recorded separately. Actual Android and iOS remain NOT TESTED. No deployment/release.
